rationale: Session HITL approval is recorded without approver identity for this bounded receipt-v2 schema-only remediation. Preserve receipt-v1 identity and create an explicit v2 contract that models all emitted and bound receipt fields. Do not silently reinterpret historical values: embedded ClaimProof digest and persisted-record digest have distinct semantics. Code, documentation, and tests are separate later ownership. No dispatcher, hook, configuration, generated-file, deploy, publish, push, credential, secret, account, external, raw-PII, or broad refactor action is authorized. No AGY retry may occur until both remediation lanes freeze, formal QA passes, and a fresh decision/snapshot is approved.
